QuestInfo.name: Battleground Outlaw
QuestInfo.1: The Specters have managed to separate the two commanders from the rest of the group. Your only option now is to defeat them all.\r\n#r(If you fail this battlefield quest, you must forfeit the quest and restart it.)#k
QuestInfo.2: You defeated the Specters and saved the soldiers! Now you can head over to the #bCommander Barracks#k.

1.0: Wow! I can't believe you took them all out just like that! And confusing them by dropping right into the middle of their encampment was a stroke of brilliance! You're amazing!\r\n

0.msg: Good eye, Commander. Beldar sent me. I want to join Reclamation HQ.\r\n

1.msg: I should introduce myself. I'm Edea, Supreme Commander. Thanks for your help, but you don't look like one of ours...\r\n

2.msg: My story is... complex. But make no mistake, I refuse to lose any fight, and I'll be a valuable asset.\r\n

3.msg: Well, you're not the first to come to us with a complicated past. And if Beldar recommended you, I'd say you're trustworthy. Let's talk later, and I'll tell you more about Reclamation HQ.\r\n
